title: Zaldy Co gave Martin Romualdez a shirt as gift, not 'maleta' – witness

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A prosecution witness told the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Thursday that he saw former Ako Bicol party-list Rep. Zaldy Co give a shirt as a “gift” to former House Speaker Martin Romualdez, not “maleta” (suitcase) with cash. Police Maj. Hermelo Dichoso, team leader of Co’s security team, testified during the bail hearing of Romualdez, who faces a plunder case stemming from alleged kickbacks from infrastructure projects worth P7.44 billion. READ: Witness: Zaldy Co’s alleged kickbacks have acknowledgment receipts Co, the former House appropriations committee chairperson during Romualdez’s speakership, was a co-accused in the case.
